markdown:
**Source** [Sky King's Tomb Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=208) pg. 13 To Clan Tolorr, history shouldn't be dry and boring; it deserves to be engaging and made relevant to the living. You couldn't agree more! Whether it's your hobby or career, you've developed a reputation for translating the past into the present through demonstrations, period performances, acting out famous events, donning replica armor, and other feats of living history—filling in a few historical blanks if it makes a better show. Having learned of your passion, Clan Tolorr has sponsored your visit to Highhelm so that you can learn from each other. It's a wonderful opportunity, and Tolorr puppetry arts, storytelling, props, and historical rigor are the stuff of legends. Already, you've begun researching dwarven history so that you're prepared for whatever lies ahead. Choose two ability boosts. One must be to **Strength** or **Charisma**, and one is a free ability boost. You're trained in either the [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) skill or the [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14) skill, and you're trained in the [Dwarf Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill. If you selected Performance, you gain the [Impressive Performance](/Feats.aspx?ID=793) skill feat. If you chose Society, you gain the [Dubious Knowledge](/Feats.aspx?ID=776) skill feat.
**Connection:** Bulgra Veldollow, a matriarch in Clan Tolorr and accomplished puppeteer
**Reputation Points:** +0
